We closed our Series A on Tuesday. I want to write down what the last 14 months actually looked like, because the announcement version leaves out the middle.

We almost died in October. A signed term sheet fell through two days before Thanksgiving, and we had nine weeks of runway. What saved us was boring: we called every customer with an annual contract up for renewal and asked them to prepay for a discount. Six said yes. That bought four months.

I do not have a grand lesson. We survived long enough to get lucky, and we kept the team small enough that surviving was possible.

We are hiring two engineers now. The careers page has details.
